test.title: Trees of the city park — information board

paragraphs.text: The oak beside the east gate was planted in 1811 and is the oldest tree in the park. The tallest is a poplar of 34 metres, near the lake. In spring the cherry avenue flowers for about two weeks.
paragraphs.label: A

paragraphs.text: Park staff plant sixty new trees each autumn. Visitors can adopt a tree for £40 a year, which pays for watering during the first three summers. Guided tree walks take place on the first Sunday of each month.
paragraphs.label: B
